title: feat(spec): the view display page size defaults to 50 — PaginationConfigSchema.pageSize .default(25) → .default(50)
body:
Fixes #20050
Clause-②: no

## What

The view display page size defaults to **50**. `PaginationConfigSchema.pageSize` in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` moves from `.default(25)` to `.default(50)`. That is the only declaration of the view display default. Maintainer ruling, verbatim (objectui#9853, batch #223 item 4): 「9853 默认页大小改为50」. The change goes into the protocol first: the renderer reads the spec default (objectui#9853 ruling C′ item 1), and no renderer hardcodes 50.

## Contract face: accept set unchanged, one default moved

- **Default:** `ui/PaginationConfig:pageSize` moves from `25` to `50`. This is the only default the build's ratchet saw move (`📌 1 declared default change(s) accepted (#4666): - ui/PaginationConfig:pageSize: 25 → 50`).
- **Accept set:** unchanged. The type is still `z.number().int().positive()`. The refusal pins `should reject negative pageSize`, `should reject zero pageSize` and `should reject non-integer pageSize` (`view.test.ts`) still pass without edits, and so does the component-arm cross-check (`component-object-grid-pagination-accept-set.pin.test.ts`). Measured on the built dist: `PaginationConfigSchema.safeParse({ pageSize: 0 })` is refused with `too_small` at `pageSize`.
- **Describe text:** unchanged, byte for byte. It still reads: "Number of records per page. On a view with no pager (kanban, gallery, timeline) it is the fetch ceiling, and the renderer owes two things: bound its fetch at this number, and, when the filtered set is larger than it, show a visible truncation signal saying what is on screen is not the whole set". The schema docblock gains one paragraph naming the ruling and stating that the renderer reads this default.
- **Parse outputs, measured on the rebuilt `packages/spec/dist`:**

  | input | parsed `pagination` |
  | :--- | :--- |
  | `ListViewSchema` with `pagination: {}` | `{ pageSize: 50 }` (was `25`) |
  | `ListViewSchema` with no `pagination` | absent, before and after |
  | `ListViewSchema` with `pagination: { pageSize: 25 }` | `{ pageSize: 25 }` |

- **Published JSON Schema:** `json-schema/ui/PaginationConfig.json` now has `pageSize.default: 50`.

## Sweep of every text stating the display default as 25, counted by declaration

The declaration census covers every `pageSize` `.default(` under `packages/spec/src`. It finds 3 declarations: `ui/view.zod.ts` (25, this card), `kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts` (50) and `marketplace/marketplace.zod.ts` (20). The last two are out of scope per the card and untouched. Texts restating the view default:

| text | what it said | this PR |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `view.zod.ts` `PaginationConfigSchema.pageSize` | `.default(25)` | `.default(50)` |
| `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/ui.json` (generated) | `ui/PaginationConfig:pageSize = 25` | regenerated by the build to `= 50` |
| `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` (generated), 3 rows: `ListView.pagination`, `ObjectListView.pagination`, `## PaginationConfig` | `optional (default: 25)` | regenerated by `gen:docs` to `optional (default: 50)` |
| `view.test.ts` pin `should default pageSize to 25` | `toBe(25)` | flipped to `should default pageSize to 50` / `toBe(50)` |
| `view.test.ts` pin `should accept custom page size` | input `pageSize: 50` | input changed to `25`. With a default of 50 an input of 50 could no longer tell "the authored value survived" from "the default applied", so the pin now uses a non-default value |

**Deliberately unchanged.** None of these states the current default:

- `component-object-grid-pagination-accept-set.pin.test.ts` docblock table row `| view — PaginationConfigSchema | …default(25) | no |`. Its column header is `declaration before #19046`, so it is a historical record and still accurate.
- Authored `pagination: { pageSize: 25 }` values: `plugin-approvals` `sys-approval-request.object.ts` (3 list views) and the CLI view scaffold template (`packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts`). These are explicit author choices and still parse to 25.
- Other `pageSize: 25` hits in `packages/spec/src/api/metadata.test.ts`, `kernel/metadata-plugin.test.ts`, `benchmark.bench.ts` and `sdui-parser` tests. These are different surfaces or authored inputs.
- **Governed files:** none. No file under `skills/**` or `docs/adr/**` states the view page-size default (grep for page size / pagination with 25, zero hits).
- **Hand-written docs / examples:** none. No hand-written page under `content/docs/**` (outside `references/`) or `examples/**` states a page-size default of 25.

## Surfaces this needed beyond the claim's list (measured, not optional)

1. **`packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts`** gains the row `ui/PaginationConfig:pageSize` `from '25'` `to '50'`. Without it `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` fails with `❌ 1 authorable key(s) changed the DEFAULT they apply when the author omits them: - ui/PaginationConfig:pageSize: 25 → 50`, and the gate prints this exact row to add. The row's `reason` states what moves and the one-line way to keep 25.
2. **Semantic migration entry `view-pagination-page-size-default-50`** (`src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.…ts`, plus `registry.ts` regenerated by `gen:migration-registry`). The ledger header prescribes one for a default move that reaches already-deployed silent documents. Every precedent where deployed behaviour moves has one: the autonumber `unique` default, the audience posture default and the approval escalation flip. The precedents where nothing deployed moves have none. `gen:spec-changes` and `gen:upgrade-guide` were re-run and produced zero diff, because step 18 is not projected yet. The same holds for the other 170 step-18 entries.

## Changeset level: `minor`

This is a behaviour change for every author who omits the key, with no refusal and no type change. It is not a bug fix, so `patch` would understate it. It is not a narrowing and not a removal, so it is not breaking: `Clause-②: no`, no ADR-0087 marker owed (`check-adr-0087-registration`: "this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset"), and a `major` is refused by the repo in any case. This matches the level the previous published-default moves shipped at (the `enableOnInstall` default move and the default-flip conversion class both shipped `minor`). The changeset states the behaviour change for authors who omit `pagination.pageSize` and gives a FROM → TO table.

## Reverse verification (ablation), after the fix was committed

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put back `.positive().default(25).describe(` in place of `.default(50)` at HEAD eaf5d399. The `view.zod.ts` blob `c474dcb477c7` is identical at 72e9a6a0. The anchor hit x1 → x0, and the blob went `c474dcb477c7` → `c6933f3d2587`. Then it ran `vitest run src/ui/view.test.ts`. The direction observed was the expected one, red: `Tests 1 failed | 460 passed (461)` with `FAIL … PaginationConfigSchema > should default pageSize to 50` and `AssertionError: expected 25 to be 50`. The restore was proven two ways: the blob equals the HEAD blob (`c474dcb477c7…`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The script also carried an EXIT/INT/TERM trap with an absolute path. The test imports `./view.zod` from source, so no dist leg was needed.

## Tests and gates (at `72e9a6a0`, after merging `origin/main` e2c4e125)

- `@objectstack/spec` build: exit 0 (`📌 … ui/PaginationConfig:pageSize: 25 → 50`). `check:generated`: 1 stale artifact (`content/docs/references/**`), fixed with `gen:docs`, then green.
- `@objectstack/spec` test (`--project local`): `Test Files 540 passed (540)`, `Tests 15820 passed | 2 todo`. Test (`--project repo`): `31 passed`, `579 passed`. typecheck: exit 0.
- Consumer suites (contract-face fixture triage): `@objectstack/platform-objects` `55 files / 911 tests passed`; `@objectstack/lint` `108 files / 4144 tests passed`. A repo-wide grep finds no test outside `packages/spec` that asserts a parsed view's `pagination.pageSize` (no `.snap`/JSON fixture carries one either). `plugin-approvals` / `cli` suites were not run locally; they are declared to CI (their fixtures author `pageSize: 25` explicitly).
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the actual 8 changed paths (merge base e2c4e125f) gives **112 commands**. Every one was run at 72e9a6a0, and its exit code was written to disk before any pipe. **108 exit 0.** 4 are **NOT MEASURED**; each exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET because it reads BUILT output of packages this diff does not touch:
  - `check:skill-examples` needs `@objectstack/client-react` dist;
  - `check:lean-entry-closure` needs `@objectstack/objectql` dist;
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` need the whole workspace built.

  The targeted closure build could not get the shared verify lock (two 9-minute queue timeouts), so this is a declared narrowing, left to CI. This diff adds or changes no export, type or module (`check:api-surface`, `check:dts-closure` and `check:published-files` are green). The reconciliation `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reads: `112 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 108 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED (4 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`, 0 UNRUN. Three lint-dist gates first exited 3; after the lint closure was built they were re-run green. Also run: the 5 artifact-roster gates whose roster lives in a directory this diff touches (`check-changeset-fixed`, `check:meta-url-spelling`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`), all exit 0.
- Mergeability: a driver-less `merge-tree` of this head onto origin/main `836aad2a` (7 commits newer, one of them touching `registry.ts`) is clean.
- `turbo ls --affected` is not used for any narrowing here.

## objectui (read-only, at `.objectui-sha` f8a9d0fb05)

No objectui test pins `25` as the spec default. objectui brings the spec schema in as `stripImportedDefaults(SpecPaginationConfigSchema)` (`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`), and `spec-subschema-parity.test.ts` asserts identity against that stripped object, not a value. Every `pageSize: 25` in objectui tests is an authored input. objectui#9853 is where the renderer starts reading this default. objectui was not edited.

## Acceptance notes

- The CLI view scaffold (`os generate view`) writes an explicit `pagination: { pageSize: 25 }`, so a newly scaffolded view shows 25 rows, not the platform default. It is an authored value and it validates. It is not a defect under the filing classes; noted only. Carrier: none.
- `view.zod.ts` is region-split with seat 2's #20051. This diff touches only `PaginationConfigSchema` (around line 1100). It does not touch the flattened list-overlay region (`ListViewShapeSchema.extend(flattenedViewOverlayFields()).strip()` / overlay `options`).
